subject: OCCURS clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.38.3 "The subject of the entry may be followed within that record description only by data description entries that are subordinate to it" -> OK. OdoResolve walks every ancestor level and refuses any later non-REDEFINES sibling, COBOL0856: a direct follower (probe/occurs-p1/sr22_follow) and a follower one level up (sr22_nested_follow) are both rejected. The REDEFINES exemption admits nothing illegal: a following REDEFINES sibling can only redefine the ODO table (§13.18.44 placement), which COBOL0855 rejects. A trailing level-66 RENAMES is accepted (sr22_renames_after), consistent with §13.18.45 placing 66 entries after the record's last data description entry. No negative golden pins COBOL0856.
